license_note: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent is served, not distributed, under the xAI enterprise terms and acceptable use policy that already govern the reviewed Grok records. The policy forbids using the service or its output to develop competing machine learning models and forbids distilling model data or outputs. No weights are released.

license_evidence.scope: Business access to Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent through the SpaceXAI API and related services
Acceptable-use, anti-distillation, and competing-model restrictions incorporated into xAI service access

access_boundary: This record represents Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent under the dated API model name grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309, with the grok-4.20-multi-agent name as its alias, as announced with Grok 4.20 on March 10, 2026. The reviewed Grok 4.20 reasoning and non-reasoning snapshots, later Grok releases, and the multi-agent beta feature as a product surface are separate boundaries.
strengths: A dedicated model page names the dated model name, its aliases, the context window, regions, and rate limits
A separate capability guide documents the 4-agent and 16-agent configurations and which output is returned
tradeoffs: The model page and capability guide both carry a beta label, and the page lists several beta and experimental aliases
Closed weights served only through the xAI API under terms that bar competing-model development and distillation
